remarks: Welcome to this highly upgraded condo in the heart of Ventura! The first floor features an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area, along with a convenient half bath and covered porch. An attached two-car garage is located just off the kitchen. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, a loft, and two upgraded bathrooms. The primary suite includes a private bathroom, walk-in closet, and balcony. A second-floor laundry area adds everyday convenience, and the washer and dryer are included in the sale. Notable upgrades include an updated kitchen and bathrooms, newer carpet and flooring, crown molding, and shutters throughout. A Ring camera is also included. Soft water system is leased. VA as
